## Natural history notes

A small silk moth characterized by bright pink and yellow wings, a fuzzy yellow body, and a soft rounded appearance that makes it one of the most distinctive moths in Florida. In Florida, the Rosy Maple Moth is found in hardwood forests, hammocks, forest edges, parks, and wooded neighborhoods where maple and other host trees occur. Adults are nocturnal and do not feed, while the caterpillars feed on the leaves of maples and related hardwoods, sometimes in groups when young, before pupating in the soil.
